versand.kanal.im_account_einrichten: set it up in your account
versand.kanal.code_eingeben: enter the code in your account
versand.kanal.sms_ab_standard: SMS is available from the Standard level
versand.premium_sms.hinweis.nicht_verfue: Premium SMS is available from the Premium level
versand.premium_sms.hinweis.gelernt: The device has reported in — briefings go to the learned reply address.
versand.premium_sms.hinweis.verfallen: Reply address expired — Garmin may have assigned the number to another device by now. As soon as the device reports in again, the channel can be used again.
versand.premium_sms.hinweis.nie_gemeldet: The device has never reported in — the reply address is learned on first receipt.
versand.briefing.lead.route: The trip briefing is a stage table — email carries all columns, Telegram the first {telegram_spalten}, SMS has no grid, plain text.
versand.briefing.lead.vergleich: The location comparison is a wide table — in practice it goes by email. Telegram carries only ≤ {telegram_spalten} columns, SMS has no grid, plain text.
versand.zeitplan.kein_kanal_text: Turn on at least one briefing channel above to see schedule options here.
versand.zeitplan.vergleich_intro: As with a trip: the {morgen} shows today, the {abend} shows tomorrow. You only choose the time.
versand.zeitplan.morgen_sub: Same day — everything for today’s stage
versand.laufzeit.route_sub: The end date comes from the stages — it is maintained there, not here.
versand.laufzeit.ohne_ende: Delivery continues without an end date.
versand.naechstes.nachgeholt: running now / will be caught up
versand.ziel.unbekannt: Delivery target unknown — the account profile is not available; nothing is sent.
versand.ziel.keine_adresse: No email address is set in the account — nothing can be sent.
versand.ziel.unbestaetigt: The address {adresse} is not confirmed — nothing is delivered.
